routes.reviewNote: The ethereum GLDT token is the verified custom Ownable ERC-20 (owner-only payable mint()/batchMint() and burn1-burn4 events carrying bytes32 ICP destinations — a canister/chain-key bridge pattern) whose owner() on all three EVM chains is the bridge-operator EOA 0x70ae25592209b57f62b3a3e832ab356228a2192c (read 2026-07-20). Omnity's official token table lists GLDT (ICP ledger 6c7su-kiaaa-aaaar-qaira-cai) for ICP-to-EVM routes, so the bridge is attributed to Omnity Network; the EOA's operational identity is not officially labeled (attribution inferred). EVM footprint is tiny (~5.3k GLDT on Base, single-digit elsewhere).

Omnity's official token table lists GLDT (ICP ledger 6c7su-kiaaa-aaaar-qaira-cai) for ICP-to-EVM routes, so the bridge is attributed to Omnity Network; the EOA's operational identity is not officially labeled (attribution inferred). EVM footprint is tiny (~5.3k GLDT on Base, single-digit elsewhere).

The arbitrum GLDT token is the verified custom Ownable ERC-20 (owner-only payable mint()/batchMint() and burn1-burn4 events carrying bytes32 ICP destinations — a canister/chain-key bridge pattern) whose owner() on all three EVM chains is the bridge-operator EOA 0x70ae25592209b57f62b3a3e832ab356228a2192c (read 2026-07-20). Omnity's official token table lists GLDT (ICP ledger 6c7su-kiaaa-aaaar-qaira-cai) for ICP-to-EVM routes, so the bridge is attributed to Omnity Network; the EOA's operational identity is not officially labeled (attribution inferred). EVM footprint is tiny (~5.3k GLDT on Base, single-digit elsewhere).

Canonical home deployment: the GLDT ICRC-1 ledger canister 6c7su-kiaaa-aaaar-qaira-cai is the native issuance; its icrc1 minting account is the GLDT swap canister 6f6ua-hqaaa-aaaar-qairq-cai (minting-account read via the ICRC API 2026-07-20), whose sole controller is the Gold DAO SNS root tw2vt-hqaaa-aaaaq-aab6a-cai (ic-api canister read). GLDT mints only when GLD NFT gold certificates are locked in the swap canister.
